title: A disappointing weekend in Prague
situation: Last month you went on a weekend trip to Prague with a travel company. Unfortunately, the trip was very different from what was promised in the advertisement below. Write an e-mail of complaint to the company.
situationHu: Egy utazási iroda prágai hétvégéje egészen más volt, mint amit a hirdetés ígért; írj panaszlevelet a cégnek.
stimulus:
EUROTRIPS – PRAGUE WEEKEND BREAK
• Comfortable, air-conditioned coach
• 3-star hotel in the city centre, 5 minutes' walk from the Old Town
• Guided walking tour in English
• All this for only €189!

points.text: describe what went wrong compared with what the advertisement promised
explain how these problems spoilt your trip
say what you expect the company to do

modelAnswer.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the weekend trip to Prague that I took with your company last month.

According to your advertisement, we would travel on a comfortable, air-conditioned coach, stay five minutes' walk from the Old Town and have a guided tour in English. However, the coach's air conditioning did not work, and the hotel turned out to be on the outskirts, forty minutes away by tram. To make matters worse, our guide spoke only German.

As a result, we arrived exhausted after a hot journey and wasted hours travelling every day. Since I could not understand the guide, I learnt very little about the city's history.

I believe I am entitled to a partial refund, and I expect a full explanation and an apology.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours faithfully,
Levente Varga

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a levél pontról pontra veti össze a hirdetés ígéreteit (légkondicionált busz, belvárosi szálloda, angol nyelvű vezetés) a valósággal, megmutatja a következményeket, és világosan megfogalmazza az elvárást.
Hangnem: határozott, de udvarias panaszlevél – Dear Sir or Madam / Yours faithfully, összevont alakok és sértő megfogalmazás nélkül; a követelés tárgyszerű (I believe I am entitled to …).

Szövegalkotás: logikus felépítés (cél – ígéret és valóság – következmény – elvárás), a panaszlevél jellegzetes kapcsolóelemeivel: According to your advertisement, However, To make matters worse, As a result.
Szókincs: érdemes megtanulni: turned out to be, on the outskirts, I am entitled to a partial refund, I look forward to your prompt reply.
